data.exact_reserve_text: Included within net claims incurred of GBP 20.2m (2018: GBP 65.5m) is a deterioration of GBP 1.2m (2018: improvement of GBP 4.6m) to claims reserves established at the prior year end principally due to unfavourable developments on a number of classes with partially offsetting favourable developments on the Pecuniary Loss and Casualty classes.
data.standardized_narrative: The Syndicate recorded a net prior year strengthening of GBP 1.2 million in 2019, representing a 1.4% deterioration of its opening gross claims outstanding. This was primarily driven by unfavourable developments across several classes, partially offset by favourable developments in the Pecuniary Loss and Casualty lines of business. The Syndicate ceased underwriting with effect from 1 January 2018 and entered a run-off phase, with the 2016 and prior years of account having been reinsured to close at the end of 2018.
raw_causal_phrases: unfavourable developments on a number of classes
partially offsetting favourable developments on the Pecuniary Loss and Casualty classes
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development figure is NET of reinsurance as no gross figure was explicitly stated or calculable from available tables. The claims development table on page 13 is not a full triangle and is distorted by a significant RITC adjustment, making it unsuitable for calculating total prior year development. Some gross written premiums are negative due to adjustments/cancellations exceeding new business in a run-off scenario.
